raw_value_text: A NeuronCore-v2 consists of four heterogeneous compute engines (Tensor, Vector, Scalar, and GpSimd), each designed to accelerate different types of operators in modern machine learning models. Each compute engine has its own sequencer, which is responsible for instruction fetch, decode, and issue. The four compute engines execute four independent instruction streams asynchronously in parallel.

Each compute engine has its own sequencer, which is responsible for instruction fetch, decode, and issue. The four compute engines execute four independent instruction streams asynchronously in parallel.
